summary.what_this_is_not: This is not a model score and not a claim that any model is wrong. It measures whether each item could DISTINGUISH a correct solution from a deliberately broken one. An item counted unfalsifiable may still have a correct reference solution; what it lacks is a suite that would have noticed otherwise.
